$comment: Zero-cost rule (DECISIONS.md, D-002). 'allowed': OSI-approved permissive licenses plus CC0-1.0. 'reviewed': exact package + license pairs accepted after review, each with a reason.

reviewed.reason: Its LICENSE file is BSD-3-Clause; package.json only says "BSD". Pulled in by VitePress, for the docs site.

Browser usage data, not code. got-scraping uses it (through header-generator and browserslist) to send realistic browser headers. CC-BY-4.0 is a free data license; the package carries its own attribution.
